description: public.utf16-external-plain-text from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/styled.rtf (a hand-written RTF with bold/italic/both runs, two fonts, a red colour-table entry and one \'e9 accent), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: UTF-16 *little*-endian with a ff fe BOM, despite 'external' conventionally implying network byte order. Not in rclip-core's UTI table, so it resolves to Flavor::Other.
